summary: HS 82 cm at 2380 m (aspect/slope not given; 'Collapsing, localized'): basal DH 4-8 mm 0-20 cm (1F-) under FC 20-42 (1F, 2-4 mm) and FC 42-60 (4F, 2-3 mm), then a 'problematic' DF 0.5 mm layer 60-76 (4F-) and 6 cm of F DF; buried SH 6 mm at 60 cm with CT4 SC (x2) and ECTN4; CT25 SC at 20 cm; temperatures -3 C at the ground to -13 C at 60-72 cm
reading_issues: Hardness bars, boundaries (20, 42, 60, 76 cm) and temperature dots measured from pixels (temperature axis 28.9 px per degree C, ticks every 2 C). The temperature profile has no surface reading: its top two points are at 72 and 60 cm (both -13.0 C), 10 cm below the 82 cm snow surface; air temperature is blank. Aspect and slope are blank in the header (left null; the earlier 12 Dec pit labelled 'Dolomite Shoulder' was at 2280 m, S, 15 deg, a different spot ~300 m away). The Specifics text is truncated on the chart ('Collapsing, localizec'), so it may continue. 'x2 on SH 6mm' is non-bold free text on the CT4 test (count 2, failure on buried SH 6 mm at 60 cm, a boundary with no separate SH layer on the bar chart). The red line at 60 cm is the weak-layer marker at the base of the flagged 60-76 cm layer. ECTN4 read as no propagation at 4 taps. CT25 SC at 20 cm sits on the DH/FC boundary, layer_grain left null. DF slash glyphs and the DH caret are clear; moisture D (dry) for all layers.
